data.title: The page on the screen

memoryNodes.cue: Maya opens the presentation in a browser.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 玛雅在浏览器中打开展示。

memoryNodes.cue: It hides part of the heading.
The page no longer needs the old program.

data.situation:
For the presentation, Maya borrowed a laptop and Jo used a tablet. The figures were visible on Maya’s screen, but part of the heading was hidden behind a menu. She opened the page in another web browser. The laptop was a means of showing their work, not the work itself. Dr Chen explained that the tablet’s main function today was to let visitors look through the room photographs. Jo: The old instructions say we need to install a special program.
Maya: Those instructions are outdated. The page opens in the browser now.
Jo: Is there a technical problem with the screen?
Maya: No. I only need to close this menu.
She closed it. The whole title appeared above the graph, and Jo carried the tablet to the reading corner.

readingBlocks.en: For the presentation, Maya borrowed a laptop and Jo used a tablet. The figures were visible on Maya’s screen, but part of the heading was hidden behind a menu. She opened the page in another web browser. The laptop was a means of showing their work, not the work itself. Dr Chen explained that the tablet’s main function today was to let visitors look through the room photographs.
readingBlocks.zh: 展示时，玛雅借来笔记本电脑，乔使用平板电脑。数字在玛雅屏幕上可以看见，但部分标题被菜单挡住。她用另一个浏览器打开页面。电脑是展示工作的手段，并不是工作本身。陈博士解释，今天平板的主要功能是让访客浏览房间照片。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: The old instructions say we need to install a special program.
Maya: Those instructions are outdated. The page opens in the browser now.
Jo: Is there a technical problem with the screen?
Maya: No. I only need to close this menu.
She closed it. The whole title appeared above the graph, and Jo carried the tablet to the reading corner.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：旧说明书说要安装专门程序。
玛雅：那些说明已经过时了。现在可以在浏览器中打开页面。
乔：屏幕有技术故障吗？
玛雅：没有。我只需要关掉这个菜单。
她关掉菜单。完整标题出现在图上方，乔把平板带到阅读角。

glossary.zh: 某物的用途或作用；功能

glossary.zh: 已过时、不再符合现状的
glossary.note: outdated information/instructions；不等于一切旧东西都无用。
